text.card: A red giant 3,817 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.88 solar masses and 6.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,821 K at its surface.
